observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Maxmech Electric Drill.
The box identifies the model as ED 750-13.
Technical specifications are printed on the box: 750W power, 220V-240V voltage, 13mm drilling capacity.
The actual drill is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.

claims.evidence: Quality and suitability for a specific profession are subjective marketing terms.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, inferior tool.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual drill outside of the box.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or the tool may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the drill plugged in and running.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the chuck key or side handle may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all contents of the box spread out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual drill outside of the box showing its current condition.
Photo of the nameplate/sticker on the drill itself to confirm the model.
Video of the drill powered on and rotating.
Photo of the chuck key and any included accessories.
response.reason: The seller has only provided a photo of the box. I cannot verify the presence, condition, or authenticity of the drill without seeing the tool itself.
